source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"This precaution applies only to clients with the most severe grade of encephalopathy","B":"Fall precautions becoming unnecessary once the client is otherwise medically stable","C":"Hepatic encephalopathy having fairly little effect on the client's cognitive or motor function","D":"Altered mental status and asterixis (flapping tremor) associated with hepatic encephalopathy significantly increase fall risk"}}
source_row.rationale: Fall precautions are important for clients with hepatic encephalopathy because the associated altered mental status and asterixis (flapping tremor) significantly increase fall risk, an important safety consideration even in earlier grades of encephalopathy, not only the most severe.
source_row.stem: A nurse implements fall precautions for a client with hepatic encephalopathy and altered mental status. This is important because:
